entry.title: New: RES23-034 (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
PROVIDING A DECLARATION OF OFFICIAL INTENT WITH RESPECT TO MULTIFAMILY HOUSING REVENUE BONDS IN A PRINCIPAL AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $105,000,000 FOR THE PURPOSE OF MAKING A MORTGAGE LOAN TO PROVIDE FINANCING TO KOMOHALE MAUNAKEA VENTURE, L.P., A HAWAII LIMITED PARTNERSHIP, FOR A MULTIFAMILY RENTAL HOUSING DEVELOPMENT TO BE KNOWN AS MAUNAKEA TOWER.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.5 which sets a one-year filing period on pending resolutions.
